name: Mediterranean Women's Wellness Weekend ($3150 pp)
tagline: Mediterranean Women’s Wellness Weekend Experience (2 night stay)
body: All-Inclusive | Mediterranean Living & Luxury Wellness

A deeply restorative, Mediterranean-inspired women’s wellness experience designed to help you live a healthier life, reduce stress and enhance longevity, all within a luxurious, boutique coastal retreat setting.

This science-led nourishing retreat invites you to reconnect with your health through the timeless principles of the Mediterranean diet and lifestyle, outdoor movement, plant based nourishment, rest, connection, community and pleasure.
Ideal for: Best friends, sisters & mother-daughter duos, all women welcome!
Limited Availability, 3 'Duo' Weekend Tickets Only (note: 1 ticket is purchased for 2 people)
What You’ll Learn & Experience
• Learn how to implement healthy lifestyle habits that influence energy, mood, hormones and long-term vitality
• Explore the proven benefits of the Mediterranean diet & lifestyle for longevity, heart health, hormone health and brain health
• Gain practical, evidence-based tools to restore balance and support your body with confidence
• Experience deep restoration, meaningful connection & science-based education
This Retreat Is Perfect For Women Who Are:
• Seeking a science-backed, holistic approach to women’s wellness
• Wanting clarity, confidence and actionable strategies for lifelong health
• Feeling stressed, depleted or disconnected from their body
• Craving deep restoration, meaningful connection & Mediterranean-style luxury
• Ready to prioritise themselves in a nourishing, sustainable way
Bespoke Luxury Inclusions & Experience

Enjoy 2.5 days (2 nights: Friday Afternoon, Sunday night) of elevated luxury wellness, where you and your chosen retreat partner are completely taken care of from the moment you step into our private luxury transport.

With four dedicated retreat hosts, multiple industry-leading wellness experts, 5-star accommodation, and premium locally sourced South Australian food and beverages, every detail of this experience has been intentionally curated to feel seamless, personalised and indulgent.
• Tickets are purchased as a ‘duo’ due to Naiko’s twin-share luxury accommodation with king single beds
• Experiences can be tailored to your individual needs
• A pre-retreat questionnaire will be sent to personalise your experience as deeply as possible
• Please review our booking terms & conditions prior to purchase
Additional Travel Information
• Guests are required to arrange their own return flights to Adelaide Airport
• Travel insurance is mandatory and must be organised independently
• Please refer to our FAQs for airport transfer details and additional information
